claim we do not make: That the clean alpha is a point estimate
because: The profile likelihood is the statement: the compatible range is [0.08, 0.54] on the total-parameter axis, and the point estimate +0.209 is not an interval

claim we do not make: That the fitted E is a measured irreducible loss
because: It is an EXTRAPOLATED asymptote from a four-rung ladder, not the corpus's floor. The corpus's measured unigram entropy under the 6,487-token vocabulary is 4.9946 nats on the held-out region, and BOTH fitted E values lie below it (1.348 is 0.27x it, 0.706 is 0.14x it)

claim we do not make: That the ladder is CONSISTENT with Chinchilla's exponent
because: It is compatible with published exponents ACROSS THEIR ENTIRE RANGE, and therefore discriminates between none of them: the total-N alpha range [0.08, 0.54] contains 0.34 and also 0.50 and most of the plausible range, so it excludes nothing that matters

claim we do not make: That beta is consistent with Chinchilla
because: No compatibility claim may be made for beta at all: the total-N beta range is [0.36, 0.56] and EXCLUDES Chinchilla's 0.28 (the non-embedding range [0.34, 0.48] excludes it too)

claim we do not make: That our alpha is 0.34, or that it agrees with 0.34
because: The compatible range is far too wide to identify 0.34, the point estimate is +0.209, and the fold-wise estimates run from +0.118 to +0.348

claim we do not make: That the profile's compatible range is an error bar
because: It is a statement about what the data cannot distinguish, not a confidence interval and not a fit covariance; the range's width is itself the finding of the act

claim we do not make: That the non-embedding and total-parameter axes give the same answer
because: They do not: the non-embedding axis's compatible range is [0.08, 0.26] and does not contain 0.34, and its point estimate (+0.098) sits far from its own fold mean (+0.190)

claim we do not make: That the 0.8M rung is one of the two known architectures
because: Its recorded N of 694,144 matches NO MiniGPT or ALiBi shape at any (dim, layers, heads) in dims 16-256 and depths 1-10, while its embedding parameters (830,336 = 6,487 x 128) show the vocabulary and dim are as expected: it is a THIRD, unidentifiable architecture with no architecture block, run on CPU, at D/N = 22.7

claim we do not make: That the ladder's training code is in the repository
because: It is not. src/scaling/ was EMPTY before commit f1eaf77; the committed ladder script builds the SECOND family's architecture (ALiBi, 4 heads) with the FIRST family's shapes, and the script that trained the canonical MiniGPT rungs was never committed at all

claim we do not make: That the other family's runs were broken or divergent
because: They were good models with an unlucky initialisation: they reproduce from the repository's own code (133.25 / 184.49 / 224.99 against the recorded 129.57 / 183.96 / 223.77) and they finished at 3.578 nats against the canonical 3.057

claim we do not make: That the refit is a minor correction
because: It invalidated alpha = 0.445, the 'R^2 >= 0.985 on every rung' headline, and the comparison with Chinchilla, because the other family owned the entire top of the ladder

claim we do not make: That the fold standard deviation was an uncertainty on alpha
because: A standard deviation over four folds of a model whose alpha is not identified is false precision, and the point estimate sat far from the fold mean; the fold-wise estimates are quoted individually instead

claim we do not make: That the rescue has been run
because: It is in flight and unfinished: the Act 4 numbers in this paper are the current four-rung clean fit, and no rescue number is reported

claim we do not make: That the calibration result means the model can follow instructions
because: It measures next-token prediction on the training distribution; every instruction, grounding and tool task in Acts 7 and 8 is still at the floor

claim we do not make: That in-context learning is absent at 6.3M
because: The demonstration is copied, not ignored: its answer is the first generated token on 18/18 same-task items

claim we do not make: That the adapters-vs-LoRA ordering is established
because: Wilson intervals on 128 items overlap by about +/-0.04

claim we do not make: That prefix tuning 'scored zero because of a bug'
because: It did not fit: its final training loss is 3.2576

claim we do not make: That the n = 16 row of the SFT curve is an n = 3 result
because: One batch per epoch, so the seeded shuffle has nothing to shuffle

claim we do not make: That the three ICL seeds are independent
because: The model is frozen and the forward is deterministic, so the runs are bit-identical

claim we do not make: That the SFT results transfer to natural instructions
because: The task family is synthetic, not natural instructions

claim we do not make: That the ICL numbers are comparable to free-running generation numbers
because: ICL is scored teacher-forced

claim we do not make: That the LoRA rank curve has plateaued
because: It rises monotonically to r = 64 with no plateau

claim we do not make: That LoRA at rank 1 is a fair matched-budget comparison
because: Rank is pinned low by construction, and 7d shows that point is not where the curve flattens

claim we do not make: That LIMA is contradicted
because: We expose LIMA's premise (latent capability) as unsupported at this scale; the curve is learning a skill, not aligning one

claim we do not make: That the 6.3M model can ground a passage
because: It identifies the asserted number at chance, and a non-numeric passage scores the same 9/40

claim we do not make: That hallucination rates can be compared between conditions
because: The absolute rate is a ceiling of 1.000 in every condition

claim we do not make: That the model learned an operation from a tool-call format
because: It emits CALC(s): the format is acquired, the operation is absent

claim we do not make: That any result here measures factual truth
because: Numbers proxy for atomic claims and there is no fact base, so this is groundedness

claim we do not make: That the tool-call template echo means the model learned the operation
because: 0 of 40 well-formed CALC(...) calls, and in all 19 greedy template echoes the argument is exactly 's'; the format is acquired and the operation is absent

claim we do not make: That the head-ablation deltas are comparable to the published validation loss
because: The intact baseline (CE 2.8551, perplexity 17.376) was measured on this 64-sequence slice in this run, not the published 2.5152; every delta is internal to the experiment

claim we do not make: That head ablation deletes the head
because: It removes the head's CONTRIBUTION (its attention output is zeroed before it is mixed back into the residual stream); the head still computes

claim we do not make: That the rollout negative is a general claim about attention interpretability
because: It is one attribution method on one prompt family (the Act 8 number-assertion family): 0 of 34 items, against a uniform chance of 0.0078

claim we do not make: That layer 0 head 5 is the head that carries the model
because: A backup head covers for it: ablating L0 H5 together with L0 H2 costs only +0.0234 nats, the same as ablating L0 H2 alone (redundancy 0.97), and L0 H5 with L0 H0 likewise +0.0226. The effect is carried by a GROUP of layer-0 heads; L0 H5 is the one whose removal is most visible in isolation

claim we do not make: That the logit lens shows the model encodes WHICH number is asserted
because: The counterfactual-EDITED number reaches the same layer-5 median rank as the asserted number (82 against 82) and the non-numeric control reaches 86, so the lens is number-specific and not assertion-specific; the strong version of this claim is withdrawn
